svg.title: Rename, recolour and delete labels — SoftTrack web design mockup (#321)
svg.desc: Labels can be created and listed and nothing else. A Labels page in the team’s settings renames and recolours a label, with every ticket following, and deleting one asks whether to merge it into another label or remove it, and says which saved views and automation rules name it.
svg.text: · a label with a typo stops being permanent
